profile.headline: Engineering
profile.summary:
Graduated from Arkansas State University with a bachelor's degree in Computer and Information Systems Security/Information Assurance. Currently contributing as a Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech, focusing on maintaining application licensing, supporting web and mobile applications, and reducing manual work through automation. Core competencies include software industry expertise, SaaS, and Agile methodologies.  

At Walmart Global Tech, actively contributed to improving operational efficiency by collaborating on innovative automation solutions and ensuring application reliability. Motivated by a commitment to streamlining processes and empowering teams, they bring a collaborative mindset and technical expertise to enhance organizational workflows and support strategic goals.
